strings.en: I'll fight to the end as a soldier of Gadisword!
I don't intend to die in a foreign land!
Eliminating all obstacles!
Commencing attack!
For our brethren on the Rabulpaila!
We won't fall behind in space combat!
Don't think you can beat us in space combat!
We'll hold this defense line to the death!
No mercy, Sieg Altolied!
No pity for traitors!
There's nowhere to run, Sally Emil!
Prepare yourself, traitor!
We already have your data!
We won't let the Earthlings have their way!
Earthlings, you'll get no mercy!
We won't fall back a single step, Steel Dragons!
You won't get near the Rabulpaila!
I'll finish you off along with the traitors!
Die along with Fairy Klibia!
Even the Steel Dragons, if we sink their mothership...!
I'll sink their mothership!
Target, Grungust type!
Grungust type confirmed!
It's just an upgraded old model!
If I can just dodge that sword!
A Hückebein dead copy is nothing!
You vanish too!
I'll knock you right off your base!
The latest Hückebein model...!
If we hit them before they combine!
Like I'd let you combine!
Target, SRX!
A complex combining mechanism must be fragile!
A machine that can only charge in is nothing!
I have to watch out for its range...!
Hmph, a bizarre machine, just like the data says.
Its range may be wide, but with our acceleration!
It's just a defective unit!
An Alteisen knockoff is nothing!
At that size, it can't turn sharply!
Hmph, what an easy target!
With that size and color, it stands out way too much!
With all that gear, it can't move nimbly!
A high-mobility fight is just what I want!
The fastest of the Lion series...!
Speed doesn't decide who wins!
Target, Gespenst type!
A modified old model is nothing!
Target, Double G!
I'm going for the big game!
Target, Choukijin!
It looks like nothing but a monster...!
A combat Excellence...!
Its wide-area weapons are dangerous...!
Target, Cybuster!
So that's the unit Golaikunru considers a threat...!
Hmph, a new face, huh?
Even without data, I'll take you on!
You think I'll flinch at your size?!
Our mobility is superior!
Are they aliens too?!
Those guys aren't Earthlings either...?!
I won't let you go to the Rabulpaila!
Here I come, Fury!
Whatever aliens you are!
Counterattacking!
You're not getting away!
Don't think you can shake me off!
I won't let you escape!
All right, going on the offensive!
Out of my way!
I'll corner you!
I won't let you go any further!
I can't back down here!
U-Uwaaah!
It's no good, I'm ejecting!
Is this the end?!
N-Not here!!
G-Gadisword is...!!
D-Damn it! My precious unit!!
Uooaaagh!!
Wh-what?!
I can't afford to lose my unit that easily!
L-Like I'd die in a foreign land like this!
Ugh, I can't stabilize my unit!
Even if the tide's against us, I can't fall back!
Damn it, like I'd go down in a place like this!
A-A direct hit?!
No matter how cornered I am,/　as long as my unit still moves...!
W-We have the Rabulpaila at our backs!
I-I won't forgive you! I won't forgive you, traitor!
Our resolve could never be inferior to the Earthlings'...!
Th-The Steel Dragons... They're overwhelming...!
Ugh! Not by scum who teamed up with deserters!
Ngh! Damn Grungust, no more of this!
Th-That's no Hückebein/　dead copy!
Gah! Is that thing really/　a Personal Trooper?!
Damn SRX, what power!
I-I won't let it get any closer!
H-How can something so huge move like that?!
This is bad!/　Am I being overwhelmed by all those attacks?!
Is the gap in high-mobility combat really this wide...?!
D-Damn Dygenguar, it's more than just momentum!
Does the Aussenseiter have no openings...?!
Ugh! What's with its legs?!
Our mobility should be superior!/　Why can't I dodge?!
C-Can't we beat the Choukijin?!
Wh-What a fearsome thing, the Choukijin...!
H-How does it move like a human...?!
I-I can't follow Cybuster's movements!
T-Taking on the Granzon/　was a mistake...!
The enemy's seen plenty of combat, it seems!
This is bad, losing thrust will be fatal!
They read my evasive maneuvers!
For our brethren's sake, I can't lose!
Managed to avoid a direct hit somehow...!
Damn them, they're more battle-hardened/　than I thought!
A soldier of Gadisword won't retreat over this!
Blast it, Earthlings!
Damn Sieg, did you sell your soul to the Earthlings?!
You'd go that far to suck up to the Earthlings?!
Traitor, how dare you!
W-We have to stop the Steel Dragons no matter what!
A-As expected, the Steel Dragons are formidable!
If we let the Earthlings and traitors get cocky...!
Damn Grungust!/　Don't think your luck will last!
Ugh, fighting within its range/　is too risky...!
That charging power and boldness are formidable...!
Damn it, I have to do something about that turret!
S-So that's a state-of-the-art unit for you...!
The R Series is tough even alone...!
Even against the SRX, I can't back down!
Damn it, its movements are hard to read!
Isn't that thing supposed to be defective?!
Ngh! Moving like that with that bulk!
No matter how many weapons it has,/　that won't work twice!
If it turns into a contest of power...!
Faster than it looks! But it won't work next time!
The TE Absorber's output is no joke!
Does the Cerberus have no blind spots?!
Th-The intel said the Bellzelute/　didn't have this kind of firepower!
Pulling off such difficult maneuvers so easily...!
Beaten by an old model...!
C-Can anyone stop the Dygenguar?!
I-It moves just like a human...!
Who knew leg motions could be so effective...!
Blast it, enough with those weird tricks!
Tch! The Choukijin are a pain!
Damn Cybuster, it's faster than the data says!
Damn Granzon, is it getting serious now...?!
They're concentrating fire on our forces...!
Tch, just a graze!
Don't underestimate us Gadisword!
Couldn't shake them off!
Is that supposed to be a feint?!
This much is no problem!
And I can't afford to waste a single armor plate...!
I have to avoid damage as much as I can...!
Is that all, Earthling?!
Damn Sieg, you'd bare your fangs at us?!
Not only did you desert, you turn your blade on us!
Siding with the Earthlings! Have you no shame?!
Plotting rebellion was a mistake!
Is this all the Steel Dragons have?
Hmph, weaker than the data says.
Ngh, not by a unit piloted by a traitor!
All show and no substance, Grungust?!
Even a Grungust... If I just avoid a direct hit!
What's wrong? Are those fists just for show?!
All acceleration and no firepower!
Intel says it's the latest Hückebein, but...
If it's not combined, it's nothing!
Hah, so much for a one-hit kill!
Just charging in won't cut it!
Special maneuvers won't work on us!
Ngh, by a defective unit?!
That gear is a waste of space.
Is that huge arsenal just for show?!
Ngh! It's faster than the data says!
Keeping up with me in an old model...!
Is that all, Dygenguar?!
I have to watch out for its big sword...!
So big, yet it aims so accurately...!
I've no intention of taking it head-on!
I have to deflect the big unit's attacks well...!
No matter its firepower, moving that sluggishly!
The Choukijin aren't so scary after all.
Is this all?/　I don't see why Golaikunru marked them.
Like that'll hit!
Too slow!
Evasive maneuver complete!
Aim better next time!
Propellant... Still plenty left.
Useless!
So what?!
I'm fully prepared!
You didn't think that through!
Like that would work!
I fell right into the enemy's trap...!
They've sealed off my counterattack?!
At this rate, I can't touch them...!
I have no choice but to fall back for now!
Blast it, there's nothing I can do!
From this position...!
I can't counter!
Moving too much came back to bite me!
I've lost track of it...!
I can't reach them from here!
I'll back you up!
Moving to support!
I'll take care of any stragglers!
You left an opening!
Captain, I'll cover you!
I'll attack too!
I'll protect our brethren!
Fall back!
Pull back for now!
Not on my watch!
Captain, please withdraw!
Leave this to me!
Going in for the pursuit!
You stopped moving!
Can I finish it with this?!
Hit!
Take this!
Go down!
There!
First, this!
Prepare yourself!
I'll hit you!
Hah!
Hyaah!
Hyaah!
Haaah!
You're mine!
I'll tear you apart!
Go down!
Take this!
Now!
All right, I can do this!
Target locked!
Go!
Raaaagh!
